verses.text: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.

segments.text: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.

notes: 121.1 I will…: or, Shall I lift up mine eyes to the hills? whence should my help come?

verses.text: My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.

segments.text: from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.

verses.text: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.

segments.text: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.

verses.text: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.

segments.text: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.

verses.text: The LORD is thy keeper: the LORD is thy shade upon thy right hand.

segments.text: thy shade upon thy right hand.

verses.text: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.

segments.text: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.

verses.text: The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.

segments.text: The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.

verses.text: The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.

segments.text: The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.
